thread:
incident-bot: Pager - auth-service spike: failed_logins 2300/min across eu-west & us-west. Suspected account-takeover probe. See dashboard: https://redwood.example/alerts/4109. Escalation candidate.

alice: taking this. tagging @brian @cheng for SRE/auth triage. any live customer reports?

brian: on it, pulling logs now. lots of distributed IPs, similar UA strings - looks like credential stuffing from a botnet. sample UA: "okhttp/3.12" repeated.

cheng: confirmed - high-volume attempts against common usernames (finance ops svc accounts). small number of successes (probing valid creds).

dana: support side - not many inbound tickets yet but auth proxies are seeing increased 5xx for some tenants. could degrade UX if we throttle badly.

alice: need live mitigations: propose WAF tarpit for the UA fingerprint + per-IP rate limits + progressive account lockouts for hit accounts.

brian: agree. I'll push a temporary WAF rule and edge connection caps for /v1/auth. plan: tarpit + block for clearly malicious signatures, then add IP slices.

cheng: also recommend progressive lockout: >5 fails in 60s triggers captcha/2FA challenge for that account. target by risk score to avoid broad disruption.

dana: we'll prepare a support template and monitor tickets; notify customers if they hit auth challenges.

alice: action list: 1) brian -> deploy WAF rule; 2) dana -> enable auth rate-slice for anonymous traffic; 3) cheng -> enable targeted progressive lockouts; 4) alice -> coordinate comms and impact. rolling now.

brian: WAF rule applied: id w-ATO-4109 on EU+US edges. rule snippet: ```waf.rule.add("w-ATO-4109", match={"headers.user-agent":"okhttp/3.12","rate":">50/min"}, action="tarpit(2000ms),block", scope="eu,us")``` Seeing immediate reduction in successful logins from matched clients, failed attempts down ~45% in 2m.

dana: live: enabled auth rate-slice 0.1 for anonymous clients at edge to reduce fanout to backend auth service. Customers may see slower retries; monitoring CX.

cheng: progressive lockouts active for targeted username patterns. watching false positives - currently 3 suspected legitimate logins challenged, support notified.

alice: initial customer impact: low. 12 accounts prompted for 2FA/captcha in last 10m, all recoverable. prepping brief for account teams. dana, can you draft a support blurb?

dana: drafting now, will post in #support-templates in 10m. includes steps for users to complete challenge and regen tokens.

brian: tweaking WAF tarpit: increased to 3000ms to slow down retries more effectively. patch applied.

incident-bot: Alert update: failed_logins reduced to ~1100/min and trending down. Attack surface reduced. Status: mitigated -> monitoring.

alice: handing off to @kai in 35m for overnight watch. full incident writeup to follow in #postmortems. thanks for fast work.

kai: ack, taking handoff. will monitor dashboards and escalate if we see resurgence. please DM any follow-ups. :thumbsup:

alice: closing local triage. postmortem fields: detection, mitigations (WAF tarpit w-ATO-4109, auth rate-slice, progressive lockouts), CX impact, next steps (harden UA fingerprinting, add challenge flows, long-term bot fingerprint blocklist).

kai: noted, will add morning follow-up and check on support ticket queue.

incident-bot: Incident closed for paging but remains in WATCH state. last_update=4109123620.
